name: html-button-nested-rule-body-declaration-routing
description: A button rule whose body nests a style rule keeps that nested rule whole. Button declaration routing splits a flat body at ';' and lifts placement declarations such as transform onto a separate rule; applied to a body with nested rules it cut the nested block mid-way and left stray closing braces. The truncated stylesheet hid later rules from class-identity coalescing, so a RichText marker scoped to `.label.hidden-copy` was merged with every plain `.label` and its display:none hid every button label.

source_reference.notes: Product-neutral fixture: site builders ship native CSS nesting under button selectors.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
